title: pass-1 lane timing/resource stats — mechanical aggregation
method: mechanical extraction from trailer logs only; no estimates. Every reading cites its source file. A missing reading carries a reason, never a blank.
notes: peak_rss_mb is the runner's peak-RSS-by-PID walker maximum (descendant tree only). For ollama lanes (gemma4:12b-mlx, gemma4:26b-mlx, qwen3.8:27b-mlx) the model's memory lives in a daemon-owned `ollama runner` parented to `ollama serve`, NOT in the dispatched tree, so it is invisible to the walker (OWNER-LOG D15/D17).
wall_seconds comes from the runner's 'exit N in NNN.N s' line; exit_code from the runner's exit= line.

failure_reason 'host-memory cull + killpg EPERM' = host-floor guard fired (avail < 6144 MB), then tools/runner itself crashed unhandled at os.killpg (tools/runner:1554) with PermissionError, exit 1 (not 124).
